quizName:
Hardest Questions in Vermont
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you while driving?
questions.explanation: Alcohol affects the parts of your brain that control judgment and self-control. It makes you feel overly confident. Alcohol also slows your reaction time, hurts your coordination, and affects your balance. It reduces your vision and makes it hard to judge distance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What should you do before turning?
questions.explanation: Turn on your turn signal three to four seconds before you turn. This warns other drivers of your intention.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with traffic signals. It tells drivers turning left on a green light that they do not have the right-of-way. They must wait for oncoming traffic to pass first.

questions.question: What must you show when stopped for a traffic violation or equipment check?
questions.explanation: You must have your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance in your vehicle at all times. When stopped by police, you must show all three documents.

questions.question: When should you slow down?

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, near intersections, near railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp curves, where there are pedestrians, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does alcohol cause?
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol impairs your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is green.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must not pass another vehicle.
You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass, but only at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must not pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign with white background and black markings. Drivers must follow all regulation signs. This sign means passing is not allowed on this road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: When borrowing an unfamiliar vehicle from a friend, you should:

options.text: Not worry about it because all vehicles are the same.
Not tell your friend you are unfamiliar with the vehicle.
Ignore any problems to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Take a few minutes to learn where the controls are and how to use them before you drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to learn where the controls are and how to use them before you drive.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar vehicle, take time to find and understand the turn signals, lights, windshield wipers, brakes, gear selector, and horn. Fix any problems before driving.

questions.question: When you encounter an aggressive driver, you should:

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Show them you disapprove of their driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Stay calm when facing a dangerous driver. Slow down and let them pass. Keep your distance. Do not make eye contact or make rude gestures.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if no other cars are visible.
Signal only if you see other cars.
Signal only in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if no other cars are visible.
questions.explanation: Always signal when you turn, change lanes, or pull away from a curb. This is the law. Do not skip signaling just because you do not see other cars.

questions.question: Driving ability can be reduced by:
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires the driver to be in good physical condition. Alcohol, drugs, and being tired can all affect your ability to drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is usually yellow with black markings. It warns you about a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid damaging your brakes or having a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. Do not turn around where this sign is posted.

questions.question: On a freeway, if you miss your exit, you should:

options.text: Keep driving until you find the next exit or safe place to turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep driving until you find the next exit or safe place to turn around.
questions.explanation: If you miss your exit, do not back up. Drive to the next exit or safe place to turn around. Backing up on a freeway is illegal.

questions.question: Distracted driving can be caused by:

options.text: Talking or texting on a phone.

questions.explanation: Drivers must focus fully on driving. They make about 200 decisions for every mile. Any extra activity takes your attention away and creates danger.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. If you see this sign, turn around and find another way.
